title: Anomaly
description: A deterministically detected deviation for one day, derived from the ComparisonObject. Produced by anomaly.py, never by the LLM.

code.description: Stable identifier for the anomaly rule that fired (incl. Feature 003 live-stream codes).

theme.description: Grouping theme used when consolidating anomalies into nudges.

severity.description: Mapped from the triggering metric's evaluation_tag.

signals.description: Comparison signal keys that triggered the anomaly (provenance).

evaluation_tag.description: Copied from the triggering MetricComparison for traceability.

detail.description: Short deterministic description, e.g. 'stress 28% above 30-day baseline'.
